propositions: Outbound create operations currently fail closed when targeting projects other than the single configured project, due to fixed project references in transport constructors and pre-flight cross-project validation
Create target project must be resolved per-ticket against the projects mapping and stamped into the mutation before dispatch, covering both Cloud and Data Center transports
The cross-project guard should validate target keys against the set of synced projects rather than exact equality with a single configured project
Stale or typo'd bridge_project bindings pointing to unsynced projects must not emit create mutations or pass pre-flight validation
Reserved key _bridge_target_project must be dropped from Data Center create fields to prevent transmission as a bogus Jira field
Single-project store behavior must remain unchanged when projects mapping is absent or contains one project
